source_read: Complete, 501 lines; every section/subsection/subsubsection heading is mapped below.
scope: Only G was edited within the package. All prior G labels, bibliography keys, equations, toric/charged derivations, and scoped failure mechanisms are retained; the whole manuscript is translated in place into mathematical English and uses article. Additions synthesize existing L/C results with explicit derivations; organization is not counted as new mathematics.

sections.source_heading: 共同问题：研究结论必须落在哪里
sections.notes: The interval quantifiers, one-sign affirmative route, and same-dimension two-sign disproof requirement were already explicit. The full text is translated, not shortened.

sections.source_heading: 第三主线的中心：把两种性质放到同一个光滑对象上
sections.notes: Expanded the fixed-object table to separate N#N, E_D, the specified BCGP resolution, and the seven-line resolution. Resolution complex structure, another complex structure on the same real manifold, and mixed-chirality filling are distinct objects.

sections.source_heading: 曲面丛：已有全局信息远多于“缺不存在性”
sections.notes: Retained all slow-interpolation, higher-order, TT, and inverse-operator material. Added direct global-attainment and structural-bridge explanations from the long paper, without claiming a new Einstein existence or nonexistence theorem.

sections.source_heading: 原稿的拓扑与精确变分值
sections.notes: Added metricwise CGB derivation of full curvature energy, attainment iff Einstein, the strict volume window, and the C1 normalized exact-path volume variation. Other functional nonattainment does not imply nonattainment of full curvature energy.

sections.source_heading: 端点退化是一项条件性结构，而不是所有精确解的归宿
sections.notes: The existing endpoint paragraph is retained under a new precise locator: an additional exact Einstein sequence with volume tending to the lower endpoint is assumed. Neither capture of all volume nor injectivity of the entire core is asserted.

sections.source_heading: 谐和方法真正剩下的数学问题
sections.notes: Added the actual adapted-submersion hypotheses, harmonic Bochner defect/equality argument, area-source formula, Euler pairing, and target TT variation. The optimized nonconformal example has a near-Einstein product source, not an exact Einstein metric on E_D. Fiber-volume normalization cannot be combined with the pre-normalization Einstein equation.

sections.source_heading: 代数平滑：证明存在的全局路径
sections.notes: New G section presents actual smoothing as positive Einstein existence on the specified real smooth type. Added explicit simultaneous-resolution charts after finite base change and the Ehresmann pullback step. Hypotheses are only finitely many A1 singularities, ample K_X, complex minimal resolution, and an actual QG smoothing; arbitrary mixed-chirality fillings are excluded.

sections.source_heading: BCGP指定乘积商的实际证明链
sections.notes: Integrated the specified branch triples, genus/node count, nonhyperellipticity, character vanishing, Lee–Park globalization, and ample-canonical argument from C. Corrected the Serre-duality display to H^2(T_X^0)^*, not H^2(T_X^0) without dual. Nonzero H^2 elsewhere invalidates this sufficient criterion, not all smoothing.

sections.source_heading: 七线Campedelli是另一个具体对象，不与BCGP合并
sections.notes: Integrated the seven lines and inertia labels, covering algebra, six independent-label triple points, canonical formula, and actual branch-perturbation smoothing. This is a separate fixed smooth object; no diffeomorphism or moduli-component identification with BCGP is asserted.

sections.source_heading: 高度四典范环和QG形变：保留更广的代数内容
sections.notes: Added the ring, canonical covering stack, Ext dimensions, and all-Artin local rigidity. Global QG unobstructedness does not smooth the Wahl point: its local smoothing parameter vanishes at every Artin order, not merely to first order. Natural locally trivial unobstructedness/moduli conclusions retain their comparison, marking, descent, and minimal-Weierstrass/Wahl/ADE hypotheses.

sections.source_heading: 图流形：局部极限允许，困难在全局粘合代价
sections.notes: Retained the full graph calculations and emphasized that exact hyperbolic local models are allowed; local forbidden-spectrum arguments from general-type near-equality problems cannot be transplanted. The unknown cost is global peripheral and gluing compatibility.

sections.source_heading: 指定范畴、体积与Weyl预算
sections.notes: All detailed hypotheses, pointwise Ricci algebra, Weyl concentration, and the extra gradient/diameter assumptions were already in G and are retained in full English.

sections.source_heading: 双曲连接和的已闭合固定目标间隙
sections.notes: Retained the degree-two BCG/CGB proof, all Einstein signs, exact threshold, and target dependence. A lower bound tending to zero as chi(N) grows does not construct small-defect inputs.

sections.source_heading: 完整连接器方程：只解法向或切向都不够
sections.notes: The pre-existing self-contained full-matrix connector derivation is preserved, including the independent mixed block and the distinction between discrete fitting and a continuous metric.

sections.source_heading: Gaussian表示及约束
sections.notes: Retained q/K/S derivative relations, connection contraction, cancellation of S^2, scalar/momentum constraints, and physical norm computation.

sections.source_heading: 端点数据与非交换矩阵参数化
sections.notes: Retained noncommuting exponential derivatives, true central and outer jets, normal sign reversal, all six matrix fields, and the distinction between C2 and smooth matching.

sections.source_heading: 加权法向平衡揭示长度代价
sections.notes: The physical-distance weighted identity already retains the central deficit, endpoint mean-curvature error, and full shear. No normal-only estimate is promoted to a full construction.

sections.source_heading: 确有可用的外扩尾部，但要有可达的出口
sections.notes: Retained the actual tail construction, full Ricci blocks, cutoff-derivative dependence, entrance data, and high-frequency amplification. The central entrance and a common continuation length remain unconstructed.

sections.source_heading: 周边格点、共同缩放与相对Chern--Gauss--Bonnet
sections.notes: Existing cover and relative-CGB derivations are retained; added the explicitly volume-normalized common-factor cancellation.

sections.source_heading: 格点缩小不改变局部Ricci，却必须真实来自覆盖
sections.notes: Retained the concrete Ratcliffe–Tschantz block, peripheral rank proof, number of lifted cusps, cover/tail volumes, and joint N,R scale requirement.

sections.source_heading: 相对CGB约束的是同一个闭拼接
sections.notes: Added the normalized identity but retained the actual smooth closed matching, Euler budget, and both exterior curvature and reference-volume corrections. Exact hyperbolicity cannot be inferred from e^(2r)q0 unless q0 is flat.

sections.source_heading: 带荷与无twist连接器：不能把一个模型的障碍推广到另一个
sections.notes: All OT and charged proofs from the prior G are retained and translated in place, including the failure of the source-free upper bound under twist.

sections.source_heading: 无twist完整双端模型的独立结果
sections.notes: Retained exact outward-expanding end hypotheses, separator existence, the weighted CD(-K,4) resolvent argument, and normalization of the positive threshold. No extension to all graph metrics is claimed.

sections.source_heading: 坐标荷不等于物理荷
sections.notes: Retained constant coordinate charge versus variable physical Q, the physical mixed-source norm, and exact OT-open-set versus asymptotic Q-to-zero distinctions.

sections.source_heading: 稳定分隔面能控制什么
sections.notes: Retained the full Jacobi/capacity/Maxwell derivation, long- and short-circle height bounds, fully stable exact spiked Koiso germs, and charged stable centers. One-slice stability gives no uniform normal-energy bound or common collar thickness.

sections.source_heading: 真正有用的是完整有源恒等式
sections.notes: Retained the log-Q transverse term, correct maximum-principle sign, Noether derivation and pairing, second weighted moment, and scalar redshift countermodel with its unsatisfied orbit/horizontal equations.

sections.source_heading: 双端问题必须共享数据
sections.notes: Retained shared central parameters, tensor-valued returns, connection holonomy, actual affine peripheral data, mixed-order symbol, excluded spurious indicial mode, and discrete-versus-continuous limitations.

sections.source_heading: 正分支：整数拓扑与完整方程必须一起满足
sections.notes: The prior full toric restoration is preserved, including corrected topology and corner compatibility, not reduced to a topic summary.

sections.source_heading: 杆、角点与实际光滑类型
sections.notes: Retained primitive lattices, smooth/orbifold determinant criteria, parity, integral intersection forms, and the CP2 three-blow-up fan proof. The standard hexagon is not #2(S2xS2).

sections.source_heading: 无twist对角模型的完整方程
sections.notes: Retained all horizontal and vertical equations, rod flux and unit slopes, actual separated local germs, second-end cone-angle obstruction, fifth-order constant-rod mismatch, and the exact scope of the alpha/rectangle/regular-polygon failed routes.

sections.source_heading: 非塌缩、覆盖与高维的真实范围
sections.notes: Added explicit Myers/Bishop–Gromov/Cheeger–Naber hypotheses and conditional simply connected volume amplification using the maximum Euler characteristic, not the number of types. Retained equivariant descent, input-only product propagation, and higher-dimensional ALE kernel-bundle/connection requirements.

sections.source_heading: 论文式贯穿、下一步与本次综合的区别
sections.notes: Mathematical object organization and remaining global questions are covered at these targets. Editorial evaluation, publication recommendations, and claims about the act of synthesis are not imported or counted as new mathematics.

sections.source_heading: 来源定位：三条主线之外的基础内容也有去向
sections.notes: Source pointers remain covered by the existing G computation tables and detailed L foundation blocks. No duplicate provenance essay or separate short paper is added.
